name: Quake 4 Alpha
tagline: Quake 4 alpha released for preservation, pulled from a vintage hard drive
description: Quake 4 Alpha is a preservation release of an early Quake 4 alpha build, recovered from the hard drive of a vintage computer. It includes the playable executable, source files, and a readme, and is closely related to tech5 — the idTech 5 engine recreation from the same author that appeared in an earlier batch. For game historians, reverse engineers, and id Software fans, it is a rare artifact from the development of a classic shooter.
highlights: An early Quake 4 alpha preserved from a vintage hard drive
Includes the playable build, source files, and a readme
Sibling project to tech5, the idTech 5 engine recreation
A rare artifact for game historians and reverse engineers
curatorNote: Recovering an alpha build of Quake 4 from an old hard drive is exactly the kind of preservation work that keeps gaming history alive. Pairs beautifully with the author's tech5 engine recreation.
